name: story-questions
conclusion: story-questions (Ask) specifies 1 of 5 categories: 1 clarification rule; none for autonomy limits, approval gates, validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: clarification rules.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 1 clarification rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: the user story when none is provided.

statements.quote: If none of the above, ask the user to paste the story or point to a file.
